subject: Banking
title: Fraud in the Digital Age
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Fraud in the Digital Age.

hook.text: Digital banking fraud cost Americans $8.8 billion in 2022.

buildup.text: Authorized push payment fraud tricks victims into sending money willingly.

discovery.text: Banks use AI to detect fraud patterns: unusual locations, large transactions.

twist.text: Scammers now use AI too. Voice cloning can replicate anyone's voice from 3 seconds of audio.

climax.text: Fraud and defense are locked in an AI arms race. Each advance in detection creates a new advance in deception.

punchline.text: $8.8 billion in fraud. AI fights AI. The arms race never ends.

quiz.question: How are scammers using AI in banking fraud?
options: Voice cloning and deepfakes to impersonate victims and bank staff
